gloss: finding a common denominator; converting to a common denominator

definitions.gloss: finding a common denominator; converting to a common denominator
definitions.explanation: Rewriting two or more fractions so that they share the same denominator, which is what makes it possible to add or compare them. Taught in elementary school arithmetic alongside {約分|やくぶん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分数|ぶんすう}→分数：06952_bunsuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通分|つうぶん}⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's put these two fractions over a common denominator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|た}し{算|ざん}→足し算：05332_tashizan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通分|つうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Don't forget to convert to a common denominator before adding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{分母|ぶんぼ}→分母：15936_bunbo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{分数|ぶんすう}→分数：06952_bunsuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{通分|つうぶん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比|くら}べる→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧。
examples.english: With fractions that have different denominators, you convert them to a common denominator and then compare their sizes.

notes:
⟦{通|つう}→〜通：04025_tsuu⟧ (to make common, to pass through) + ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (fraction part). Used as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通分|つうぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to convert to a common denominator
- {通分|つうぶん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧: to calculate after finding a common denominator
- {最小公倍数|さいしょうこうばいすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{通分|つうぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use the least common multiple as the common denominator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{約分|やくぶん}→約分：30690_yakubun⟧: reducing a fraction to lowest terms — the opposite operation, dividing top and bottom by a common factor
- ⟦{分母|ぶんぼ}→分母：15936_bunbo⟧: denominator
- ⟦{分数|ぶんすう}→分数：06952_bunsuu⟧: fraction
